probe.title: Alexandra Tellez
probe.text_sample: Alexandra Tellez Alex Tellez Close Alex Tellez is a Director and DP working across commercial, branded, and documentary film. With an athletic background, she works to bridge commercial polish with raw unguarded moments. She's drawn to create pieces where a brand stops performing and starts feeling like something true. When she's not on set, Alex is walking her dog or chasing the perfect shot of espresso.
